question: Should full `cluster` and `refresh` unconditionally fail closed on incomplete configured-vector coverage, or preserve the v0.7.1-compatible default and expose strict coverage explicitly?
rationale: The stricter invariant improves correctness but intentionally replaces an established operator workflow and upgrade behavior, so tests alone cannot determine the permanent product contract.

options.title: Preserve compatibility by default
options.body: Keep the v0.7.1 full-run behavior and add explicit strict complete-coverage enforcement with tests for both modes.

options.title: Approve fail-closed default
options.body: Accept the operator-visible break with prominent migration guidance and live upgrade proof.

options.title: Split clustering policy
options.body: Land hydrated revision and summary work separately while deferring the default behavior change.

recommendation.title: Preserve compatibility by default
recommendation.body: Keep the v0.7.1 full-run behavior and add explicit strict complete-coverage enforcement with tests for both modes.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the existing full-cluster fallback and upgrade behavior being replaced.
